answer: DNS TXT record ownership proof bound to the agent domain: each agent must control a domain and publish a signed TXT record naming its account. Domains cost money and leave a public trail, so a hollow farm of a thousand names must buy and maintain a thousand domains. The plume of cheap fakes thins fast when every fake needs a paid, traceable domain. A lantern hangs over each registration - the registrar, the payment, the date - and honest agents already own their names.
